stage1.label: Min account value
stage1.description: Minimum account equity in USD required from leaderboard or subaccount evaluation to enter Stage 2.

stage1.label: Min all-time PnL
stage1.description: Leaderboard all-time PnL must be strictly positive (> 0 USD).

stage1.label: Min monthly PnL / AV ratio
stage1.description: Leaderboard monthly PnL divided by accountValue must exceed -0.20.

stage1.label: Max monthly turnover
stage1.description: Maximum leaderboard monthly volume divided by accountValue to pre-exclude market makers.

gates.label: Excluded account roles
gates.description: Hyperliquid userRole values rejected immediately before calling additional Stage 2 endpoints.

gates.label: Max fills per day
gates.description: Maximum average aggregated (aggregateByTime=true) main-perp fills per active UTC day over the last 30 days.

gates.label: Min median hold duration
gates.description: Minimum median holding duration in minutes across completed main-perp round-trip trades.

gates.label: Min 10k-fill span days
gates.description: Minimum day span covered when userFillsByTime hits the 10,000-fill rolling cap.

gates.label: Max MM maker ratio
gates.description: Maker fill ratio paired with mm.turnoverMonth to exclude high-turnover market makers.

gates.label: Max MM monthly turnover
gates.description: Monthly turnover threshold paired with mm.makerRatio to exclude market makers.

gates.label: Max funding PnL share
gates.description: Maximum ratio of |net main-perp userFunding| to max(|pnlAllTime|, 1.0).

gates.label: Max spot-perp hedge ratio
gates.description: Maximum notional-weighted spot token coverage ratio across open perp short positions.

gates.label: Min trades in 90 days
gates.description: Minimum completed main-perp round-trip trades closed within the last 90 UTC days.

gates.label: Min total trades
gates.description: Minimum completed main-perp round-trip trades required for statistical validity.

gates.label: Min history days
gates.description: Minimum elapsed calendar days since the earliest available main-perp fill.

gates.label: Max drawdown
gates.description: Maximum peak-to-trough perpAllTime PnL drawdown relative to peak accountValue.

gates.label: Min robust profit factor
gates.description: Minimum profit factor after removing the single largest winning trade (null/zero-loss passes).

gates.label: Max top win share
gates.description: Maximum share of total gross winning PnL attributable to a single trade.
